nom: Peace Out Oil-Absorbing Pore Treatment Strips

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who says patches are usually hard to use on her skin type, report the strips absorb a lot of oil from the nose and cheeks and leave pores looking less clogged.
segments.dry: One reviewer who is normally dry reports her T-zone still gets very oily and the strips helped there, and another with combination-but-dry-leaning skin says the strips did not leave her skin feeling dry afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe using the strips specifically on oily nose and chin areas, reporting reduced clogged pores, fewer or shorter breakouts, and one saying she saw little visible difference despite the treatment.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports irritation from using the strips, while others describe the strips as gentle and non-irritating without stating sensitive skin explicitly.
segments.mature: One reviewer identifying as a 65-year-old reports smoother, smaller-looking pores in her T-zone and nose after two uses.

concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible reduction in blackheads and clogged pores on the nose and chin after overnight use, though a few say they saw no visible difference in their pores despite repeated use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say the strips reduce breakouts, cystic pimples, or clusters of acne and make extraction easier afterward; one reviewer reports the strips ripped out facial hair rather than removing debris.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers describe strips pulling large amounts of oil and sebum from the nose and T-zone, calling the extracted material visible and heavy; one reviewer found no gunk on the strip at all after six hours.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report the adhesive left red marks or stinging skin for hours or days after removal, while others say removal was painless and non-irritating.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the strips did not dry out her skin and left it feeling hydrated, while another with sensitive skin reports irritation after use.

aspects.libelle: Visible gunk and oil on strip

extraits.texte: I was really excited to try these but sadly was not a fan. Using these caused my skin to get irritated. I do have have sensitive skin so I will definitely think twice about using these if you can relate.

I'm going to preface this by saying I was in a rush so I only left them on for 2 of the recommended 4-6 hours. However I can't see how this would affect it, if anything it seems like less time would make them easier to remove. These hurt so so bad to take off. I tried peeling them off slowly, which was excruciating. I tried going fast like a band-aid but that hurt too. After I managed to get them off my face was bright red for another 30 min and stung. My pores might have improved but I think I ripped off all my face. honestly, not at all worth it.

I have combination skin and congested skin. I initially thought this was like the ones I used to use from the drug store 15 minutes thing but this is different it needs a 3/6 hours on your pores. So I decided to sleep with them on overnight (which you can). It's a satisfying feeing to see the gunk come out. I didn't post a pic because it's not something I want the internet to see eww! Lol

extraits.titre: My nose was apparently greasier than I thought
extraits.texte: I habe combination skin and my worst pores are so large and visible on my nose. I got these when Ulta was giving acne spot treatment dots to any brand purchase. So I tried it. It did tighten up my chin, which surprised me since I didn't see anything from the mirror. My nose, though - it tightened it way up in a very visible way. Additionally, the amount of gunk visible on both sides of my nose around the base was intense. It was milk white. I considered taking a photo but it was pretty gross. Used it a second time with just as much tigghtened skin in a good way, althoughpulls there was obviously less gunk to pull out. I was bedbound for a year and a half due to illness so these had their work laid out for them, and they succeeced. It also stayed on all night, and I thrash in my sleep a lot. I also have nightmares that cause cold sweats, which happened the second time. They stayed in place, though!

I received this product for free, and was blown away by the results. My tea zone gets very oily even though I am super dry on a normal day. I'm also a make up artist so I wear a lot of foundation and products from day today. This makes my pores get yucky and causes blackheads. My pores end up being large and this product really helped! It's a 5 out of 5 for me!

This things are great! I have a combination skin, I use this on my oily areas (nose and chin). Prior to using these I used the basic pore strips but never really saw any significant improvement. Since using Peace Out, I've been getting amazing results. They've really helped prevent any breakouts around my nose and chin, and have been helping to clear my persistent blackheads!

I have used this product two times. I just couldn't believe, how much good they did for my skin. My T area and nose, it's so smooth and the pores look so small and clean. I actually just kept looking in the mirror in a smile. This company really has very good products.
